for r,row in enumerate(pat,1): grid[r][1:5]=row
for r in range(9,12): grid[r][2:6]=[0]*4
def transform(grid):
 out=[row[:] for row in grid]
 # identify 0 rectangle and source object colors; reflect source cells horizontally into rectangle
 coords=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0,8)]
 rs=sorted(set(r for r,c in coords)); cs=sorted(set(c for r,c in coords))
 zr=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if 0 in row]; zc=[c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[r][c]==0 for r in zr)]
 for i,r in enumerate(zr):
  for j,c in enumerate(zc): out[r][c]=grid[rs[i]][cs[-1-j]]
 return out
result=transform(grid)

open(path,'w').write('from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0).most_common(1)[0][0]
    coords = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0, background)]
    rs = sorted(set(r for r, c in coords))
    cs = sorted(set(c for r, c in coords))
    zr = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if 0 in row]
    zc = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[r][c] == 0 for r in zr)]
    for i, r in enumerate(zr):
        for j, c in enumerate(zc):
            out[r][c] = grid[rs[i]][cs[-1-j]]
    return out
')
